module_summary: Extracts a timestamp from AXI-stream tuser on the first beat of each frame, using a mid-frame flag register to qualify valid.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Mid-frame flag set after non-last beat; suppresses timestamp valid until next frame start

anchors.name: m_axis_ts
anchors.why: Timestamp output: tuser shifted right by TS_OFFSET

anchors.name: m_axis_ts_valid
anchors.why: Timestamp valid pulse on first beat of frame: tvalid and not frame_reg

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input beat valid; qualifies output valid and frame_reg update

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Sideband carrying the timestamp field extracted to m_axis_ts

groups.name: frame_tracker
groups.description: Tracks frame boundaries to find first beat of each frame

groups.name: ts_extract
groups.description: Shifts timestamp out of tuser and qualifies it with first-beat valid
